articles.title: Jhansi Murder Mystery: Woman Auto Driver Shot Dead | Accused Mukesh Jha Arrested After Encounter
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jhansi Police have cracked a sensational murder case that was initially disguised as a road accident. Anita Chaudhary (35), a woman autorickshaw driver, was found dead on January 5, but what looked like a crash turned out to be a cold-blooded murder.

body.html:
Jhansi Police have cracked a sensational murder case that was initially disguised as a road accident. Anita Chaudhary (35), a woman autorickshaw driver, was found dead on January 5, but what looked like a crash turned out to be a cold-blooded murder.

The Case: Initially reported as an accident in the Nawabad area, a post-mortem requested by Anita’s suspicious family revealed she was actually shot dead. Investigations led to Mukesh Jha, who had been in a relationship with Anita for several years.

The Motive: Mukesh Jha confessed to the crime, stating he felt betrayed after Anita ended their relationship. He, along with his son and brother-in-law, planned the killing and tried to make it look like her auto had overturned.

The Arrest: After being on the run with a ₹25,000 reward on his head, Mukesh was arrested following a late-night encounter where he was shot in the leg during retaliatory firing by the police.

Watch for the full details of this investigation.

articles.title: Drunk Driver Loses Control on 100 Feet Road, Car Crashes Into Restaurant Wall in Bengaluru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A terrifying accident was caught on camera late Thursday night in Bengaluru’s Indiranagar area. A speeding Skoda, driven by 42-year-old Derrick Tony, lost control and slammed into a restaurant wall on the busy 100 Feet Road.

body.html:
A terrifying accident was caught on camera late Thursday night in Bengaluru’s Indiranagar area. A speeding Skoda, driven by 42-year-old Derrick Tony, lost control and slammed into a restaurant wall on the busy 100 Feet Road.

What Happened: Around 11:35 PM, the car was traveling from 18th Main Road when the driver attempted a high-speed left turn. The vehicle jumped the road divider, veered across lanes, and narrowly missed a group of pedestrians before hitting a two-wheeler and crashing into the building.

The Aftermath: Police confirmed the driver was under the influence of alcohol. While the two-wheeler rider, Jabir Ahmed, sustained minor injuries and is in stable condition, a major tragedy was narrowly avoided. The Jeevan Bheema Nagar Traffic Police have registered a case and are investigating.

Drive Responsible. Don't Drink and Drive.

articles.title: Rare 6-Foot "Garuda" Eagle Rescued by Farmers in Mirzapur | Heartwarming Wildlife Rescue
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a remarkable display of humanity, farmers in Gotwan (Gotma) village, Mirzapur, saved a rare, giant eagle—locally known as a "Garuda"—after it collapsed mid-flight due to the extreme cold wave.

body.html:
In a remarkable display of humanity, farmers in Gotwan (Gotma) village, Mirzapur, saved a rare, giant eagle—locally known as a "Garuda"—after it collapsed mid-flight due to the extreme cold wave.

The Incident: On Friday morning, the nearly six-foot-long bird fell into agricultural fields in the Kachhwa area. Villagers found the majestic bird shivering and surrounded by stray dogs.

The Rescue: Local farmers Govind and Sherupal acted quickly, rescuing the bird from the dogs and taking it to their home. To battle the freezing temperatures, they wrapped the eagle in a blanket and provided warmth using a bonfire. Thanks to their timely compassion, the bird’s condition stabilized.

Official Action: The Forest Department was alerted via the 112 helpline and has since taken charge of the bird's recovery and care.

Watch to see how the community came together to save this rare messenger of nature.

articles.title: Lover Kidnaps Girlfriend’s 1-Year-Old to Force Her Hand, Caught on Train
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man who abducted his married girlfriend’s one-year-old son to pressure her into eloping was arrested at Kanpur Central railway station in Uttar Pradesh. The accused, Hemant Kumar, had arrived in Delhi from Bihar on Friday to meet the woman.

body.html:
A man who abducted his married girlfriend’s one-year-old son to pressure her into eloping was arrested at Kanpur Central railway station in Uttar Pradesh.

The accused, Hemant Kumar, had arrived in Delhi from Bihar on Friday to meet the woman. When she refused to leave with him, he allegedly kidnapped her child on the pretext of buying a toy and fled on the Vikramshila Express.

After the child went missing, the woman lodged a kidnapping FIR at Kapashera West police station in Delhi. Using CCTV footage and technical surveillance, police traced the accused’s movement and alerted authorities in Kanpur.

As the Vikramshila Express reached Kanpur Central around 8.10 pm on Friday, RPF and GRP teams surrounded the train and searched all coaches. The accused was found in the rear coach with the child and was arrested.

Inspector S N Patidar, in-charge of the RPF post, said the accused initially denied the offence but later confessed, admitting he hoped the woman would follow him after the abduction.

During the rescue, a female RPF constable comforted the crying child, fed him milk, changed his diaper and kept him warm until he fell asleep. On Saturday morning, the child was safely handed over to his mother. The accused will be produced before a court and sent to jail.

#KanpurNews #ChildKidnapping #UPPolice #RailwayAlert #CrimeNews #BreakingNews #PublicSafety

articles.title: Temple Priest Accused of R*pe in Gwalior, Caught by Villagers Inside Shrine
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An 18-year-old woman has accused a 65-year-old temple priest of s*xual assault after he allegedly broke into her house and gagged her in a village under Karhiya police station limits in Gwalior district.

body.html:
An 18-year-old woman has accused a 65-year-old temple priest of s*xual assault after he allegedly broke into her house and gagged her in a village under Karhiya police station limits in Gwalior district.

According to police, the incident occurred on the night of January 4 when the victim was sleeping at home. Her brother and sister-in-law were away, while her mother, who is mentally unwell, was present in the house. Taking advantage of the situation, the accused, identified as Hariram, a priest at the village’s Siddheshwar Temple, allegedly entered the house.

In her statement, the victim said the priest entered her room, gagged her with a cloth when she resisted, and threatened to kill her using occult practices before committing the assault. He allegedly fled after threatening her with consequences if she spoke out.

The victim reportedly remained silent for one to two days due to fear before informing her family. The family, along with villagers, later caught the accused at the temple. During the confrontation, another priest allegedly assaulted the accused. He was then handed over to the police.

A Zero FIR was registered at the women’s police station and transferred to Karhiya police station. The accused was arrested from Shivpuri district and will be produced before a court. Further investigation is underway.

Additional SP (Rural) Jairaj Kuber confirmed that a case has been registered and strict legal action will be taken.

#GwaliorCase #TemplePriestArrested #CrimeNews #JusticeForVictim #MPPolice #BreakingNews #SocialAlert

articles.title: "All India Pregnant Job" Scam Busted! | Men Scammed for ₹10 Lakhs in Bihar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Nawada Cyber Police in Bihar have busted a bizarre online fraud known as the "All India Pregnant Job" scam.

body.html:
The Nawada Cyber Police in Bihar have busted a bizarre online fraud known as the "All India Pregnant Job" scam. Fraudsters lured men with promises of ₹10 lakh to impregnate women, only to duel them out of thousands in "registration fees."

In this video, we deep dive into the modus operandi of the Nawada cyber gang. Using misleading advertisements on Facebook and WhatsApp, the scammers promised victims:

Huge financial rewards (up to ₹10 Lakhs).
Lures of "Playboy Services" and "Free S*x."
Fake "Dhani Finance" or "SBI Cheap Loans" to build trust.

The victims were asked to pay "initial charges" for hotel bookings and registration. Once the money was sent, the scammers vanished or began blackmailing the victims, who often stayed silent due to social stigma.

Superintendent of Police Abhinav Dhiman confirmed the arrest of Ranjan Kumar and the detention of a m!nor. This video serves as a warning to stay away from "get rich quick" schemes and suspicious social media advertisements.

articles.title: Racing Audi Turns Jaipur Street Into Death Zone, CCTV Exposes Horror
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A speeding white Audi car caused a deadly accident near Kharbas Circle in Jaipur’s Journalist Colony (Patrakar Colony) on the night of Friday, January 9, 2026.

body.html:
A speeding white Audi car caused a deadly accident near Kharbas Circle in Jaipur’s Journalist Colony (Patrakar Colony) on the night of Friday, January 9, 2026.

Police said the luxury car was allegedly racing another vehicle at nearly 120 kmph when it hit a road divider, went out of control and ploughed through roadside food stalls and pedestrians for about 30 metres before crashing into a tree.

At least one to two people were killed and 16 others injured. One of the deceased has been identified as Ramesh Bairwa, a roadside vendor from Bhilwara. Several victims were thrown onto the road, and more than 10 food stalls were destroyed.

Shocking CCTV footage shows the Audi mowing down people, triggering panic in the crowded area. Four critically injured victims were admitted to SMS Hospital Trauma Centre, while others were shifted to Jaipuria Hospital. Some injured were later discharged.

Police identified the driver as businessman Dinesh Rinwa from Churu. The three-month-old Audi, registered in Daman and Diu under a trust’s name, reportedly had expired insurance. The driver and two others fled the spot, though locals caught one occupant and handed him over to police. Authorities suspect the occupants were drunk.

The damaged car has been seized, and a manhunt is underway. The incident has sparked public outrage over reckless and drunk driving in Jaipur. Investigation continues.

#JaipurAudiCrash #BreakingNews #CCTVFootage #DrunkDriving #RecklessDriving #JaipurNews #RoadSafety #PatrakarColony

articles.title: Helmet Attack After Minor Crash: Zepto Delivery Executive Beaten on Bengaluru Road
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru: A Zepto delivery executive was brutally assaulted in the Mahadevpura area on Friday following a minor collision with two men on a scooty, triggering concerns over road rage and the safety of gig workers.

body.html:
Bengaluru: A Zepto delivery executive was brutally assaulted in the Mahadevpura area on Friday following a minor collision with two men on a scooty, triggering concerns over road rage and the safety of gig workers.

According to police and eyewitnesses, the attackers thrashed the delivery rider and struck him on the chest with a helmet, causing him to collapse at the spot. The incident occurred while the executive was on duty, navigating busy city roads under delivery pressure.

Police said an investigation is underway to identify the accused and ascertain the circumstances leading to the assault. Civic groups have expressed alarm over the rising incidents of road rage and the growing risks faced by on-demand delivery workers in urban areas.

#BengaluruNews #RoadRage #Zepto #GigWorkers #DeliverySafety #UrbanCrime #Mahadevpura #BreakingNews
